cta.title: Have a need, or still finding your direction?
cta.text: Let’s start with a conversation about where your business is now.
process.understandText: We listen, understand your team’s work, and agree on priorities.
process.buildText: We discuss the flow and design first. Development includes agreed review points.
process.supportText: After handover, we discuss guidance, maintenance and what comes next.
services.title: Make digital useful.
services.intro: A website that explains your business. A system that helps your team. A product that meets a need. We choose the next step together.
services.processTitle: From a conversation to something you can use.
services.supportTitle: Support belongs in the project plan.
services.supportText: Before we begin, we agree on handover, documentation, support and maintenance. You know who to contact and what the engagement includes.
faq.startQ: Do I need a complete brief?
faq.startA: No. Tell us how your business works, what gets in the way, and what you want help with. We can clarify the needs from there.
faq.supportA: Guidance and support are discussed from the start. Scope, duration and maintenance follow the project agreement rather than an unlimited-support promise.
faq.costQ: Can I get a price and timeline?
faq.costA: Yes, once the needs and priorities are clear enough. The proposal explains scope, stages, time and costs for you to review.

about.title: A partner for your digital next step.
about.intro: Since 2022, Digvation has helped small and medium businesses find digital steps that fit how they work. We start with real needs and stay involved as the solution becomes part of everyday work.
about.storyTitle: It began with businesses ready for their next step.
about.storyText: Digvation began in 2022 with the aim of helping small and medium businesses take care of their digital needs. Clear websites, better organized work, and systems people can use every day. From that starting point, we aim to be a partner who thinks, builds, and supports the next step alongside you.
about.journey1Text: Helping small and medium businesses go digital, starting with the needs closest to their everyday work.
about.journey2Text: Shaping the direction, building solutions, helping people use them, and discussing the next improvements with business owners.
about.journey3Text: Continuing to develop our capabilities and maintain the quality of our work. As our reputation grows, Digvation aims to support larger businesses while keeping a personal, open way of working.
about.value1Text: A useful solution starts with understanding the business, before listing features.
about.value2Text: Scope, decisions and boundaries are made clear together.
about.value3Text: Handover and support are part of the conversation from the beginning.

privacy.title: Your privacy.
privacy.intro: Information you share is used to respond to your business needs.
privacy.formsText: When sending is enabled, your name, business, email, needs and message are sent to the endpoint configured by the site owner. An email provider may process messages for delivery. When sending is disabled, the brief is only downloaded to your device. Avoid including sensitive information in your message.
privacy.analyticsText: Analytics and ad pixels load only when configured and you agree. Names, emails and message content are not sent as analytics events. Your choice is stored on your device and can be changed below.
privacy.rightsText: Contact Digvation through the available channels to request access, corrections or deletion of information you have sent. The site owner should complete this policy to reflect actual operations before launch.
cookies.title: Help us understand visits?
cookies.text: If you agree, configured analytics and pixels are used to understand site use and marketing.
